LPC Exported Functions

group LPC_Exported_Functions

Functions

void LPC_DeInit(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx)

Reset LPC.

参数:

LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

void LPC_Init(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, LPC_InitTypeDef *LPC_InitStruct)

Initialize LPC peripheral according to the specified parameters in LPC_InitStruct.

Example usage 

void driver_lpc_init(void)
{
    LPC_InitTypeDef LPC_InitStruct;

    LPC_StructInit(&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Channel   = LPC_CAPTURE_CHANNEL;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Edge      = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_EDGE;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Threshold = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_THRESHOLD;
    LPC_Init(LPC0,&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_Cmd(LPC0,ENABLE);

    LPC_INTConfig(LPC_INT_LPCOMP, ENABLE);

    NVIC_InitTypeDef NVIC_InitStruct;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannel = LPC_IRQn;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelPriority = 2;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelCmd = ENABLE;
    NVIC_Init(&NVIC_InitStruct);

    LPC_NvCmd(LPC0,ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • LPC_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a LPC_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void LPC_StructInit(LPC_InitTypeDef *LPC_InitStruct)

Fill each LPC_InitStruct member with its default value.

Example usage 

void driver_lpc_init(void)
{
    LPC_InitTypeDef LPC_InitStruct;

    LPC_StructInit(&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Channel   = LPC_CAPTURE_CHANNEL;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Edge      = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_EDGE;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Threshold = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_THRESHOLD;
    LPC_Init(LPC0,&LPC_InitStruct);
}

备注

The default settings for the LPC_InitStruct member are shown in the following table:

LPC_InitStruct member

Default value

LPC_Channel

LPC_CHANNEL_ADC0

LPC_Edge

LPC_Vin_Below_Vth

LPC_DebouncEn

DISABLE

LPC_DebouncDiv

LPC_DEBOUNCE_DIV_1

LPC_DebouncCnt

0

LPC_Threshold

LPC_2000_mV

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • LPC_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a LPC_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void LPC_Cmd(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable LPC peripheral.

Example usage 

void driver_lpc_init(void)
{
    LPC_InitTypeDef LPC_InitStruct;

    LPC_StructInit(&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Channel   = LPC_CAPTURE_CHANNEL;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Edge      = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_EDGE;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Threshold = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_THRESHOLD;
    LPC_Init(LPC0, &LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_Cmd(LPC0,ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of LPC peripheral. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable LPC voltage detect.

    • DISABLE: Disable LPC voltage detect.

void LPC_INTConfig(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, uint32_t LPC_INT, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the specified LPC interrupts.

Example usage 

void driver_lpc_init(void)
{
    LPC_InitTypeDef LPC_InitStruct;

    LPC_StructInit(&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Channel   = LPC_CAPTURE_CHANNEL;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Edge      = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_EDGE;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Threshold = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_THRESHOLD;
    LPC_Init(&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_Cmd(LPC0,ENABLE);

    LPC_INTConfig(LPC0,LPC_INT_LPCOMP, ENABLE);

    NVIC_InitTypeDef NVIC_InitStruct;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannel = LPC0_IRQn;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelPriority = 2;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelCmd = ENABLE;
    NVIC_Init(&NVIC_InitStruct);

    LPC_NvCmd(LPC0,ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • LPC_INT -- [in] Specify the LPC interrupt source to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • LPC_INT_LPCOMP: Voltage detection interrupt.

    • LPC_INT_LPCOMP_AON: Wakeup voltage detection interrupt.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the specified LPC interrupt. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable the LPC interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Disable the LPC interrupt.

void LPC_WKCmd(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable wakeup signal to power sequence.

Example usage 

void driver_lpc_init(void)
{
    LPC_InitTypeDef LPC_InitStruct;

    LPC_StructInit(&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Channel   = LPC_CAPTURE_CHANNEL;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Edge      = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_EDGE;
    LPC_InitStruct.LPC_Threshold = LPC_VOLTAGE_DETECT_THRESHOLD;
    LPC_Init(LPC0,&LPC_InitStruct);
    LPC_Cmd(LPC0,ENABLE);

    LPC_INTConfig(LPC0, LPC_INT_LPCOMP, ENABLE);
    LPC_INTCmd(LPC0,ENABLE);
    LPC_WKCmd(LPC0,ENABLE);

    NVIC_InitTypeDef NVIC_InitStruct;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannel = RTC_IRQn;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelPriority = 2;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelCmd = ENABLE;
    NVIC_Init(&NVIC_InitStruct);
}

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the specified LPC wakeup interrupt. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable LPC wakeup signal to power sequence.

    • DISABLE: Disable LPC wakeup signal to power sequence.

FlagStatus LPC_GetFlagStatus(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, uint32_t LPC_FLAG)

Get the specified LPC interrupt flag status.

Example usage 

if (LPC_GetFlagStatus(LPC0, LPC_FLAG_LPCOMP_AON) == SET)
{
    DBG_DIRECT("LPC AON");
}

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • LPC_FLAG -- [in] Specify the LPC interrupt flags. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • LPC_FLAG_LPCOMP: Voltage detection interrupt flag.

    • LPC_FLAG_LPCOMP_AON: Wakeup voltage detection interrupt flag.

返回:

The status of LPC Flags Definition.

  • SET: The LPC flag has been set.

  • RESET: The LPC flag has been reset.

void LPC_ClearFlag(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, uint32_t LPC_FLAG)

Clear the specified LPC flag.

Example usage 

if (LPC_GetFlagStatus(LPC0, LPC_FLAG_LPCOMP) == SET)
{
    LPC_ClearFlag(LPC0, LPC_FLAG_LPCOMP);
}

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • LPC_FLAG -- [in] Specify the LPC flag. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • LPC_FLAG_LPCOMP: LPC counter comparator interrupt flag.

ITStatus LPC_GetINTStatus(LPC_TypeDef *LPCx, uint32_t LPC_INT)

Get the specified LPC interrupt status.

参数:

  • LPCx -- [in] Select the LPC peripheral. Refer to LPC Declaration.

  • LPC_INT -- [in] Specify the LPC interrupts. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • LPC_INT_LPCOMP: voltage detection interrupt.

返回:

The status of LPC interrupt.

  • SET: The LPC interrupt status has been set.

  • RESET: The LPC interrupt status has been reset.
